title: Zesty Spicy Egyptian Plum Tomatoes Skillet
description: A spicy and snappy Egyptian dish featuring plum tomatoes, perfect for a solo dinner, dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped plum tomatoes, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Use a mortar and pestle to pound the ingredients together, releasing the flavors and oils.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Zesty Spicy Egyptian Plum Tomatoes Skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
